name: avfs
desc: Virtual file system that facilitates looking inside archives
why: A virtual filesystem that lets you cd into archives and compressed files as if they were directories, a quietly lovely idea.

brief.what_it_is: AVFS is a virtual file system that lets ordinary programs look inside archived or compressed files, and access remote files, as if they were directories. Per its homepage it supports floppies, tar and gzip, zip, bzip2, ar and rar files, plus ftp, http, webdav, rsh/rcp and ssh/scp sessions, and more handlers come through Midnight Commander's external FS. The input is an archive or remote location; the output is ordinary file access to its contents.
brief.why_it_exists: The homepage says AVFS enables all programs to look inside archived or compressed files, or access remote files, without recompiling the programs or changing the kernel.
brief.how_it_works: The homepage says the shared library that supports AVFS with LD_PRELOAD is licensed under the LGPL, which suggests it hooks file access through a preloaded library. The homepage does not explain the mechanism further, so this is an inference from the licensing note.
brief.standout: Existing programs are meant to get archive and remote access without being rebuilt or the kernel being touched, which is the unusual part compared with tools that need their own commands. The homepage also lists Pavel Machek's podfuk as a similar project.
brief.status: unknown. The homepage has no release date, last-commit date, or changelog, and I did not find a version number or download target in the text I received. The sourceforge-hosted site alone is not evidence either way.
brief.caveats: The homepage gives no platform list, install steps or version information. The LD_PRELOAD mechanism implies Unix-like systems, but the page does not say so. The page states AVFS comes with ABSOLUTELY NO WARRANTY. Licensing is split: GPL for AVFS overall and LGPL for the shared library. I did not follow the Download or mailing-list links because their targets were not visible in the fetched text.
quotes: AVFS is a system, which enables all programs to look inside archived or compressed files, or access remote files without recompiling the programs or changing the kernel.
Quite a few other handlers are implemented with the Midnight Commander's external FS.
